name: collective
description: Read-only MCP access to The Collective retrieval gateway — search Alice (Glowming brand + ops knowledge) and ask the personas (Iris / Zac / Heyu / Alice). Scope is enforced gateway-side by the token. Internal — Riven OSS only.

gateway_token.title: Collective gateway token
